title: New! The Nations Bungalow w/Driveway & Yard
description:
Stay in this comfortable and centrally located home in Nashville’s booming Urbandale Nations neighborhood! This 3-bedroom, 2-bath retreat offers a bright, open living space, full kitchen, and a fenced yard—perfect for pets. Relax by the fire pit or enjoy outdoor dining. With plenty of off-street parking and top-rated restaurants and breweries just around the corner, you’ll have everything you need for a perfect stay!

The space
Welcome to your home away from home! This charming single-story, private home offers a comfortable and spacious stay in the heart of Urbandale Nations. With three bedrooms and two bathrooms, this home is perfect for families, groups, or business travelers.

Enjoy a bright and inviting living space with large windows for natural light, a comfortable sofa, and a well-equipped kitchen. The home provides plenty of sleeping options, including a king bed, queen bed, and a single bed with a trundle.

Step outside to a large, fenced-in backyard, perfect for relaxing or letting kids play or your fur baby to get some energy out, and take advantage of ample driveway parking. With just a few steps for entry, this home is easily accessible for all guests.

Conveniently located just minutes from local restaurants and shopping, and with easy access to downtown Nashville, you’ll be close to it all:
📍 5.6 miles to Vanderbilt Medical Center
📍 4.2 miles to St. Thomas Medical Center
📍 9 miles to Lower Broadway

Whether you're here for work, play, or a little of both, this comfortable and well-located home is the perfect spot for your stay in Nashville!

Guest access
Guests have full access to the home, driveway, and backyard.
